notes.fact_box: President Vladimir Putin will visit India at the invitation of Prime Minister Narendra Modi for the 2025 Annual Summit. The visit aims to review progress in bilateral projects including defence, space, energy, and trade cooperation.

prelims_pointers.text: Putin's visit to India is scheduled for 4 to 5 December 2025.
